feeds.title: QC Event School Blog
feeds.description: QC Event School Blog offers online education in event planning to students all over the world. In this blog you will find latest industry trends, event planning and wedding planning tips and recommendations.

feeds.title: Eventmobi Blog
feeds.description: EventMobi is an event app platform worldwide reaching thousands of event planners and millions of attendees in over 40 countries.Supporting a variety of organizations from the Fortune 500 to professional associations, we're a unique team of tech nerds and event planners striving to make events more impactful.

feeds.title: EventSource.ca Blog
feeds.description: The EventSource.ca wedding and special events blog provides inspiring local content, up-to-date industry news, curated recommendations, and all the latest trends for planning any type of special event. EventSource.ca is Toronto & GTA's go-to marketing and lead generation platform dedicated to the city's top special event industry professionals.

feeds.title: Eventure Blog
feeds.description: At Eventure Blog, you will find all news regarding corporate events and parties Tech, Food, Design and Drink. Eventure is a full-service event planning company based in Montreal, Canada. Our experience is in event planning, catering, production, event staffing, party lighting, and bar service.

feeds.title: Canadian Special Events Magazine
feeds.description: Canadian Special Events Magazine is Canada's # 1 resource for planners and suppliers of special events and meetings. We keep Canada's event and meeting industry connected through online, in print and face to face marketing and networking. It reports from around the world on event industry news, current trends, the people and of course the events in this dynamic industry and covers what Canadian event professionals want to know now.

feeds.title: Event Certificate
feeds.description: An event planning blog for event planners looking to learn about event planning and wedding planning. A resource to enhance your event planning knowledge.

feeds.title: Tigris Events
feeds.description: Tigris is an award winning brand experience agency specializing in dynamic personnel, promotions, marketing and events. Headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, we have over 2,000 temporary staff on our roster across Canada as well as an experienced team of account managers to turnkey events for maximum ease and cost-effectiveness.

feeds.title: Event Suppliers Network - Event, Party & Wedding Planning Blog
feeds.description: The Event Suppliers Network (ESN) provides event planners and event planning enthusiasts with an invaluable online resource for finding the best venues, event technology, restaurants, accomodation and event planning inspiration.
